evals.prompt: Identify technical debt in our codebase
evals.expected_output: Categorizes debt by type (design, test, dependency, documentation), ranks each item by impact and remediation effort, and produces a plan with owners and sequencing rather than a bare list.

evals.prompt: When should we actually pay down this debt?
evals.expected_output: Recommends paying down debt at natural touchpoints (before the next feature in the same area, when change frequency is high), weighs risk of deferral, and avoids big-bang rewrites without a safety net.
